content: In most comic book storylines and adaptations, Superman is significantly stronger than Batman. Superman has superhuman strength, invulnerability, flight, heat vision, and other powers, while Batman relies on intelligence, technology, and martial arts skills. However, Batman has occasionally been shown to have contingency plans to potentially defeat Superman, such as using Kryptonite or other strategic methods.
